THINKING IN CONTEXT

Hi, I'm Syra.

I'm Syra Mashek, a provisionally licensed alcohol and drug counselor (PLADC) and graduate student in Clinical Mental Health Counseling at Wayne State College. I write about what happens when psychology, history, social structures, and the complexities of human experience meet. This is a space for curiosity, critical thinking, and research that doesn't have to live behind academic jargon.

I believe science should be accessible without becoming simplistic, and that our best conversations about human behavior pay attention to history, culture, lived experience, and systems of power.

My articles are research-informed educational reflections. Where I adapt academic work, I identify the original source and distinguish historical or scientific evidence from my own interpretation.
